## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Nordrhein-Westfalen lights up on the map of Germany.
> Nordrhein-Westfalen | Landeshauptstadt Düsseldorf

[dramatic] [[Nordrhein-Westfalen]], North Rhine-Westphalia, in the west, has more people than any other state: around eighteen million. Its capital is Düsseldorf, its biggest city Cologne, and it includes the Ruhr, once the heart of German coal and steel.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in North Rhine-Westphalia, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> NORDRHEIN-WESTFALEN

## On the map

{Q398}

> SCENE (question): Question card #398. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Nordrhein-Westfalen?]] Which federal state is North Rhine-Westphalia?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[3]]. Number three: the west, on the borders with the Netherlands and Belgium.


{Q397}

> SCENE (question): Question card #397. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt von Nordrhein-Westfalen heißt …]] The state capital of North Rhine-Westphalia is...

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Düsseldorf.]] Cologne is bigger, and Bonn was West Germany’s capital until 1990. But the state capital is Düsseldorf.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q395}

> SCENE (question): Question card #395. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Nordrhein-Westfalen?]] What colors are on the state flag of North Rhine-Westphalia?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[grün-weiß-rot]]. Green, white and red.


{Q391}

> SCENE (question): Question card #391. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Bundesland Nordrhein-Westfalen?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the state of North Rhine-Westphalia?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 2]], picture two: three parts: a white wavy line on green for the Rhine, a white horse for Westphalia, and a red rose for Lippe.


## How it's run

{Q392}

> SCENE (question): Question card #392. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis in Nordrhein-Westfalen?]] Which of the following is a district in North Rhine-Westphalia?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Rhein-Sieg-Kreis]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Ammerland]] is in [[Niedersachsen]], [[Nordfriesland]] is in [[Schleswig-Holstein]], and [[Vogtlandkreis]] is in [[Sachsen]].


{Q393}

> SCENE (question): Question card #393. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag in Nordrhein-Westfalen gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament in North Rhine-Westphalia elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q394}

> SCENE (question): Question card #394. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Nordrhein-Westfalen bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] From what age are you allowed to vote in local elections in North Rhine-Westphalia?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[16]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from sixteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q399}

> SCENE (question): Question card #399. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef in Nordrhein-Westfalen?]] What is the title of the head of government in North Rhine-Westphalia?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q400}

> SCENE (question): Question card #400. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat Nordrhein-Westfalen nicht?]] Which minister does North Rhine-Westphalia not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q396}

> SCENE (question): Question card #396. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Nordrhein-Westfalen über politische Themen informieren?]] Where can you find information about political issues in North Rhine-Westphalia?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Düsseldorf, grün-weiß-rot, Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Düsseldorf]]. [[grün-weiß-rot]]. And [[Ministerpräsident]].
